description: This file contains unit tests for exception safety testing utilities in the Abseil library, including tests for throwing values, allocators, constructors, and exception safety guarantees.

classes.name: ExhaustivenessTester
classes.description: Template class for testing exhaustiveness of template instantiations.

classes.name: NonNegative
classes.description: Struct representing a non-negative integer with invariants.

classes.name: NonCopyable
classes.description: Struct that is non-copyable, used for testing move semantics.

classes.name: NonEqualityComparable
classes.description: Struct that does not support equality comparison, used for testing.

methods.name: ExpectNoThrow
methods.description: Template function to assert that a function does not throw exceptions.

methods.name: TestOp
methods.description: Template function to test that an operation throws at countdown zero and not otherwise.

methods.name: CheckNonNegativeInvariants
methods.description: Function to verify that a NonNegative instance maintains its invariants.

methods.name: CheckHasResetContracts
methods.description: Function to verify that an object has been reset properly.
